page.layout: One printed page, a map plate in an engraved frame. The title is printed in the centre of the map. The page number stands at the top right, outside the frame.
page.notes: The engraved map shows faint place names, rivers and a grid, none legible enough to copy. Faint letters run along the top frame and bottom frame; they are illegible. The page number 6 is at the top right. No running head is legible. The map has no further printed text.
